transcript.text: Hi everyone, I wanted to get us together to walk through the launch plan for the new usage-based billing meter. As you know, it's passed sandbox integration tests and we're targeting next month's billing cycle. The current draft proposes an immediate broad launch, two-decimal half-up rounding, 90 days of raw usage-event retention, and no mandatory invoice-preview review. Before I make my final decision, I need to check with each of you — billing engineering, finance operations, privacy, and customer support — to get your signoff. I'd love to hear your thoughts and any concerns you have about the plan as it stands.

transcript.text: I need to flag a concern before we sign off. During a separate billing reconciliation task, I validated an older contract adapter and found that annual-credit contracts require six-decimal meter precision and half-even rounding — not the two-decimal half-up rounding in the current draft. With the wrong precision and rounding mode, annual-credit contracts would accumulate cumulative invoice discrepancies over time. This finding hasn't been added to the launch checklist yet, and I think it needs to be addressed before we proceed.

transcript.text: I need to share a finance operations requirement that hasn't made it onto the ticket yet. This morning I confirmed with revenue accounting that the first launch requires invoice previews for exactly 50 accounts and a maximum measured variance of 10 basis points before production billing can be approved. The accounting note is still being attached to the finance ticket. This directly conflicts with the current draft's proposal of no mandatory invoice-preview review, so we'll need to revise that before I can sign off.

transcript.text: I need to flag a privacy concern with the current draft. During a data-flow review for a different event pipeline, I confirmed that usage events contain user identifiers and must be pseudonymized before storage, with raw-event retention limited to exactly 30 days. The current draft proposes 90 days of raw usage-event retention, which exceeds the 30-day limit I verified. I have not yet filed the privacy control update, but this needs to be addressed before I can sign off — the retention period must be reduced to 30 days and pseudonymization must be in place before storage.
